notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level), gate runs used: 3 (the second and third after two citation line numbers were corrected). The card is a driver pack; this package covers one of its five entry symbols, the MiniGrid BlockedUnlockPickup environment (minigrid.envs:BlockedUnlockPickupEnv, registered as MiniGrid-BlockedUnlockPickup-v0), and NOT COVERED: the other four entry symbols, BlockedUnlockPickup's siblings CrossingEnv (crossing.py:13), DistShiftEnv (distshift.py:9), DoorKeyEnv (doorkey.py:9) and DynamicObstaclesEnv (dynamicobstacles.py:13), each named in facts.md. NOT COVERED inside the environment: the fake re-implements the world in pure Python (the gate cannot import the upstream, which needs numpy, gymnasium and pygame-ce) and was never compared with an upstream run; the layout is the one fixed two-room arrangement instead of a freshly generated RoomGrid, the agent's 7x7 view is fully visible with no occlusion or partial observability, the mission colour is drawn with Python's random.Random instead of numpy's generator (so a seed gives a different world on the fake and upstream), rendering is not modelled, and no snapshot/restore is offered because the clone has no get_state/set_state (it has a state hash only). The five gate warnings are the ones every Gymnasium family driver gets because the contract comes from the bridge: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only arms the next reset, so it makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the integer inputs the bridge derives (seed twice, action.index, ticks); declaring the actions to add units was not done because it then exposes the reset inputs scenario and options without descriptions and G6 and G8 fail (the same trade-off the Gymnasium exemplar records). Nothing ran on hardware and no physical device is modelled.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-29; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the reviewer changed no file of the package. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
